zh: 优化移动端多图片堆交互体验：全面重构 iOS 与 Android 卡片滑动手势与离场物理动效，卡片划走平滑飞出并伴随触感震动反馈，彻底解决误以为图片“回到原位”的视觉错觉。
移动端全面支持对话列表置顶功能：支持长按会话或点击操作菜单快速置顶/取消置顶，置顶会话常驻列表顶部专区并展示置顶标识，与 Web 端及桌面端会话偏好实时双向云同步。
保持会话自生成标题与偏好显示名称严格分层，保证历史对话标题生成与检索兼容性。
en: Optimize multi-image card stack interaction on iOS and Android: overhauled swipe-away physics and smooth exit transitions with subtle haptic feedback, eliminating visual rubber-band return illusions.
Add conversation pinning to mobile apps: support long-press context menu and action button to pin/unpin conversations to the top, fully synchronized in real-time with Web and Desktop clients.
Strictly layer session auto-generated titles and manual preferences, ensuring reliable history titling and search compatibility.
